ux_review_fixes.UX-1_container_highlight_prefix_collisio: FIXED. Was: containerHighlighted = hoverKey.startsWith(containerKey(...)) — string prefix on concatenated path keys with no segment boundary, so 'container 1' lit up while dragging inside 'container 10' ('10:0'.startsWith('1')===true), and nested [0,1] vs [0,10]. Now: hover state carries the STRUCTURED path (segment array + tab); the highlight decision is canvas-path.js containerIsDropTarget(myPath, hover.path) — a SEGMENT-wise prefix compare. Proven by canvas-path.test.js, which runs the OLD string predicate (returns true = bug) next to the new one (returns false = fix) in the same test.
ux_review_fixes.UX-2_fullscreen_hid_palette_and_inspecto: FIXED via approach (b) — expand the WHOLE workspace, not the canvas alone. Was: position:fixed;inset:0 on .chs-designer-canvas only, orphaning its grid siblings (palette/inspector) → in fullscreen you could neither drag in a field nor edit properties, and the on-screen hint ('по краям экрана') was false. Now: the --fullscreen modifier is on the OUTER .chs-form-designer grid wrapper that CONTAINS palette+canvas+inspector; each column scrolls independently (form-designer.css). All three panels stay present and functional; the hint is now true ('Палитра слева, свойства справа. Esc — выйти'). The canvas-only class chs-designer-canvas--fullscreen is deleted. Chosen over the ADR's original (unbuilt) toggle-tabs sketch because it is simpler and keeps every tool live. ADR §6 updated.
ux_review_fixes.component_test_added: FormDesigner.test.jsx (there was NO component test before — how UX-1 slipped in). Renders via react-dom/server (no jsdom in this tier): smoke (palette+canvas+inspector all present) + the fullscreen INVARIANT (canvas-only fullscreen class absent; the three panels coexist under one wrapper). UX-1's 10+-container regression is covered directly in canvas-path.test.js.
ux_review_fixes.reduced_motion_autoscroll: canvas-autoscroll.js prefersReducedMotion() added; the FormDesigner autoscroll effect does a single discrete nudge per dragover (no continuous rAF loop) under prefers-reduced-motion, so off-screen drop targets stay reachable without continuous animation. +4 tests. The CSS already suppressed the drop-indicator transition under the same media query.
ux_review_fixes.F1_root_shape_human_path_regression: binding-layout-shape.test.ts — posts a real {root:{...}} FormDesigner document to the HUMAN POST /api/forms/binding and asserts Floor-1 acceptance (was a false 409 before the classifyLayoutSave normalization); a {root:…} doc with a custom node or a dangling fieldKey still gets 409 (gate not weakened).

deviations_from_adr: ADR §4.2 planned only proof-by-shared-op-vectors between the JS and TS modules; the implementation also had to NORMALIZE the form-document shape inside classifyLayoutSave — FormDesigner sends {schemaVersion, source, root:{...}} but classifyFloorBoundary treats the passed object AS the root node and only descends .children/.tabs (never .root), so a real FormDesigner document classified as false-Floor-2. classifyLayoutSave now wraps the real root under the classifier's own {type:'root', children:[root]} contract. This is a correctness fix to the SHARED gate (helps the human /api/forms/binding path too), not a weakening — additive and covered by the wire test's Floor-1 200 case.
ADR §4.4 deferred the MCP/tool-descriptor wrapper for the assistant to a FINDING (below) — the HTTP seam + parity test are delivered; the assistant tool registration is not.
friction_events: Session dropped by an API error mid-BUILD after ~55 tool calls; resumed from the exact interruption point (spec+design committed, FormDesigner.jsx + canvas-autoscroll partial in working tree) without redoing finished work.

tsc rootDir:src forbids importing web/src JS from a src test (probed: TS7016 implicit-any) — so ops parity could NOT be proven by cross-importing both modules in one test. Resolved with a SHARED JSON op-vector fixture asserted independently by both tiers (src TS test + web JS test) — drift in either module reddens its own tier.

classifyFloorBoundary shape mismatch (see deviation 1) surfaced only when the wire test's valid-insert case returned 409 instead of 200 — required reading floor-boundary.ts's visitNode traversal to find it never descends .root.

UX_REVIEW round: the container-highlight prefix collision (UX-1) was invisible without a component/pure test — the fix required extracting the path-compare into a pure module (canvas-path.js) so it could be asserted directly against the old string logic. Confirms the reviewer's point that the missing FormDesigner test let it slip.

Fullscreen (UX-2): the web tier has no jsdom, so the fullscreen invariant is asserted structurally (the modifier class is on the wrapper, not the canvas) via react-dom/server markup rather than by toggling state and measuring layout — the strongest guarantee available without a browser-driver.

canvas_decision: ENHANCED IN PLACE (not a fork). FormDesigner.jsx already was a thin shell over the tested pure ops (form-document-ops.js) + registry + history-stack; the gaps were purely visual-feedback. Forking would duplicate ~900 lines of tested behaviour (undo, multiselect, tabs, broken-key highlight, registry-driven inspector) and risk contract drift — against the codebase's own anti-duplication discipline (FF-REG-1). Every new move still resolves to the SAME insertNode/removeNode/reorderNode/moveNode calls the machine seam uses on the server.
ux_improvements: DropIndicator (replaced DropSlot): a full-width placeholder bar shows WHERE a block will land (was a 6px sliver); the receiving container highlights (canvas-wide hoverKey → container border/background via tokens).
Cross-container move of already-placed blocks (into section/columns/tabs) keeps going through moveNode/moveNodeAcross, now with target-container highlight.
Autoscroll near canvas edges during drag (canvas-autoscroll.js — pure math + 8 tests; speed grows toward the edge via requestAnimationFrame).
Keyboard: Arrow keys move the selected block; Cmd/Ctrl+X cut and Cmd/Ctrl+V paste — all over the SAME removeNode/insertNode ops; guarded so it does not hijack typing in inputs.
Live-region (aria-live=polite) announces every move/cut/paste in human Russian ('Блок «Сумма» перемещён в «Оплата», позиция 2 из 4') — canvas-a11y.js + 7 tests.
Fullscreen canvas toggle (button + Escape); palette/inspector stay reachable.
Theme-honest: form-designer.css uses only --chs-* tokens (OBLIK G2/G6 green, 0 new hardcodes); Russian labels; working (non-stub) controls.
machine_seam: POST /api/forms/document-ops (src/http/forms-document-ops.ts): body { processKey, stepKey, op:{kind,...} }, kind ∈ {insert,remove,reorder,update,move} (closed vocabulary, unknown→400 fail-closed). Reads the current form_binding.layout (404 if none — it PATCHES existing forms; creating from scratch stays POST /api/forms/binding with a full layout), applies ONE op via applyDocumentOp → src/core/form-document-ops.ts (the SERVER TS PORT of the client JS ops), then runs the result through classifyLayoutSave — the SAME Floor-1/Floor-2 content gate extracted from POST /api/forms/binding so there is ONE judge for human and agent — and persists version+1 with the same auth/role (extractActorSlug + checkRole) as /binding. CONTRACT SHARING: the ops cannot be a runtime import (tsconfig rootDir:src + isolated web-build forbid web→src), so they are MIRRORED (TS port) with a sync obligation + a PROVEN-not-asserted parity test: a shared JSON op-vector fixture (src/core/__fixtures__/form-document-op-vectors.json) is asserted by BOTH the src TS test AND the web JS test — drift in either module reddens its tier. FINDING: the MCP/tool-descriptor wrapper (register document-ops as an assistant ToolDeclaration, per the assistant-configurator.ts pattern) is deferred — the HTTP shape is the stable contract an MCP wrapper would call.
